description: This Java class provides utility methods for converting binary data (ByteBuffer, byte arrays, input streams) into uppercase hexadecimal string representations, mainly for debugging and logging purposes.

classes.name: BinaryToHexConverter
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods for converting binary data into uppercase hex strings.

methods.name: createDebugMessageByTryingToConvertToHexString
methods.description: Converts a ByteBuffer to an uppercase HEX string, handling exceptions and creating debug messages.

methods.name: toHexString
methods.description: Overloaded methods converting byte arrays, ByteBuffer objects, or InputStreams into uppercase HEX strings.

methods.name: appendByte
methods.description: Helper method to convert a single byte into its hexadecimal string representation and append it to the StringBuilder.
